contract: Compare MP4 media time before movie edits. The independent ISO/IEC 14496-12 oracle expands stts and ctts in decode order, treats ctts and trun offsets according to their box version, reads fragment decode bases and durations, and keeps media times on the mdhd timescale across edits.

Emit kind 3 with track ID, time-base numerator and denominator, PTS, DTS and duration in per-track decode order by ascending track ID. Emit kind 7 on clean end or kind 8 on refusal. The authored timing-policy controls also compare the explicitly bounded prefix policy.
